出生地: 澳大利亚,墨尔本,维多利亚
简介:
Isabella "Bella" Heathcote is an Australian actress. She is best known for playing Amanda Fowler on the Australian television soap opera Neighbours.
Heathcote was born in Melbourne, Australia and attended Korowa Anglican Girls School. She began her career in 2008. In May 2010, she was a recipient of a Heath Ledger Scholarship.
In December 2010, Heathcote was cast in David Chase's film Twylight Zones. In February 2011, Tim Burton selected Heathcote to play Victoria Winters and Josette du Pres in his film adaptation of Dark Shadows, released in 2012.
